name: agentic-github-flow
description: Rules and skills for a pull-request workflow with Claude Code and Codex.

metadata.description: Rules and skills for a pull-request workflow with Claude Code and Codex.

plugins.name: agentic-github-flow-core
plugins.description: Core skills for a pull-request workflow with Claude Code and Codex: spec-first, requirements, open-issue, repo-docs, efficient-design, ship-change, review-change and cleanup-merged.

plugins.name: agentic-github-flow-security
plugins.description: Security review of a change or repository: secret scanning, dependency audit against OSV, and a checklist by area.

plugins.name: agentic-github-flow-web-deploy
plugins.description: Pre-deploy hardening check for a website on Vercel with Supabase and optional Google sign-in, including its mail domain and EU privacy.

plugins.name: agentic-github-flow-guards
plugins.description: Claude Code hooks that refuse destructive git commands and ask before destructive deletes and before personal data leaves the machine.

plugins.name: agentic-github-flow-issue-chats
plugins.description: Issue chats for Claude Code and Codex: each chat takes one ready GitHub issue, prepares its branch for a pull request, then starts the chat for the next issue and archives itself once its work is on GitHub.
